# Mixed rounding across automatic columns

Sixteen original controls generated by `tools/mixed_rounding_flexible_fixture.py`
from our own mixed-cell-width-content source. Two protected absolute-width cells
are followed by two, three or four automatic cells. A three-automatic-cell
variant uses unequal original labels C0/C00/C000. Paired preferred widths
6000/6001 twips and merged-footer noWrap states exercise rounding boundaries.
There are no corpus assets or font binaries.

The reference application logical Cell.Width values were read after Repaginate and without
saving the source. The hash-bound reference.json records whole twips.
These are grid observations, not PDF paint bounds or a full visual certification.

Regenerate with `python tools/mixed_rounding_flexible_fixture.py`. Capture grids
with `tools/record_mixed_width_rounding.ps1 -FixtureDirectory` pointing here.
The recorder reads manifest bodyRow/columns (defaults 3/4 for older fixtures),
and hash-binds an existing PDF only when present; it does not export a PDF.
Browser tests assert exact whole-twip grids before and after undo/reopening.
